title: Restore the YEIS lazy-loading boundary after Search/Locate integration

scope.subject: Navigation module dependency graph and initial bundle boundary

research_summary: The production build warns that the YEIS core dynamic import is ineffective because the statically imported navigation module itself statically imports Universe/index. Official ES/Vite semantics confirm that static imports eagerly join the initial module graph while import() creates an on-demand graph boundary. Keep the navigator UI and result types static, but load YEIS runtime/normalization only inside async navigation functions. This preserves one YEIS search implementation without duplicating an astronomical index.

sources.finding: Pinned MIT Universe owns the normalization/search semantics that navigation reuses.
Vite preserves lazy loading for dynamic imports; statically reachable dependencies belong to the eager graph.
Dynamic import is evaluated on demand, unlike static import declarations that make modules eager dependencies.

search_ladder.conclusion: Keep the selected YEIS mother engine and its search semantics; no replacement search product is needed.
The existing Astro/Vite build already provides the lazy module boundary needed; no bundler plugin is required.
Move YEIS runtime imports into the async navigation operations while preserving the existing destination API.
No component package can improve this module-graph issue.

coverage_matrix.capability: preserve YEIS as the single astronomical search source
coverage_matrix.decision: Do not add a second star/search index.

coverage_matrix.capability: keep heavy YEIS core out of the static navigator graph
coverage_matrix.decision: Use function-local dynamic imports for runtime-only dependencies.
Only dependency timing changes; the destination API stays stable.

candidates.name: Function-local dynamic YEIS imports inside navigation operations
candidates.reason: Restores the intended lazy boundary while retaining the single upstream search implementation and current navigator API.

candidates.name: Keep YEIS core statically reachable through navigation.ts
candidates.reason: Works functionally but defeats the existing dynamic boundary and produces Vite ineffective-dynamic-import warnings.

candidates.name: Build a separate lightweight project/star search index to avoid loading YEIS
candidates.reason: Could make the navigator light but duplicates astronomical search/ranking and creates a second mapping layer back to YEIS IDs.

decision.rationale: Preserve the static navigator shell but move all YEIS runtime-only dependencies behind import() inside async search/marker resolution. This restores code splitting without a second search index.
decision.fallback: If Vite still reports a static path into the core, inspect the remaining navigation imports and move only runtime values behind the same lazy boundary; keep type-only imports static.
